# Slashdot

> > Slashdot is the original technology news aggregation platform for software developers and tech enthusiasts, featuring community-driven content across multiple specialized sections.

Slashdot has been a cornerstone of tech culture since the mid-1990s, providing news and discussion for nerds and developers. The site organizes content across multiple vertical sections including Technology, Science, Your Rights Online, Build, Devices, and Entertainment, while maintaining a strong community submission and moderation system.

## Key Topics

- ReactOS
- Windows compatibility
- GPU drivers
- Graphics drivers
- Open-source OS
- NVIDIA
- Intel
- AMD
- Kernel-Mode Driver Framework
- Windows Display Driver Model
- Hardware support
- Right-to-repair
- Privacy and security
- Biotechnology
- NASA and space exploration

## News Feeds & Discovery

- [Slashdot Homepage](https://slashdot.org): Primary news aggregation hub for tech nerds featuring the latest stories across all categories
- [Recent Stories](https://slashdot.org/recent): Real-time feed of recently published news covering gene-editing, agriculture, and emerging tech
- [Popular Stories](https://slashdot.org/popular): Trending stories aggregated across biotech, agriculture, and technology topics
- [Alternative Homepage View](https://slashdot.org/index2.pl): Secondary homepage layout featuring ReactOS, Windows drivers, and tech news
- [Community Submissions](https://slashdot.org/submission): User-driven story submission portal enabling community participation in content curation

## Technology & Operating Systems

- [Technology News](https://slashdot.org/technology): Core technology coverage featuring ReactOS development, Windows compatibility, driver frameworks, and GPU driver support
- [Build & Hardware](https://slashdot.org/build): Hardware and DIY technology section covering device jailbreaking, right-to-repair issues, and embedded systems
- [Devices](https://slashdot.org/devices): Device news and policies covering consumer electronics, airline technology policies, and device usage trends

## Science & Innovation

- [Science News](https://slashdot.org/science): Scientific research and space exploration coverage including NASA missions, Hubble telescope observations, and comet research

## Privacy, Rights & Security

- [Your Rights Online](https://slashdot.org/yro): Digital privacy and security section covering Firefox privacy features, VPN technology, web security, and online rights

## Entertainment & Consumer Tech

- [Entertainment News](https://slashdot.org/entertainment): Entertainment and consumer technology coverage including Apple AirPods, audio technology, and media devices

## Optional

- [jeditobe User Profile](https://slashdot.org/~jeditobe): Individual user profile discussing ReactOS GPU driver development and contributions
- [BrianFagioli User Profile](https://www.slashdot.org/~BrianFagioli): Individual user profile covering Windows 11 feedback and technology commentary
